summary.intent: Complete the final two phases of a milestone (Phase 38: retire deprecated web services, Phase 39: add user-configurable vault settings) using the GSD manager as a command center, while also fixing an inline upload progress bar flashing bug.
summary.outcome: All work completed: Phase 38 removed 2,030 lines of deprecated service code (folder.service.ts + bin.service.ts), Phase 39 added a configurable VaultTab to Settings with encrypted IPNS-backed storage, the upload flash was fixed with a CSS shimmer approach, and three PRs were created (#420 merged, #422 open, #423 open) with review comments resolved.

repo: The established SDK migration pattern (useSharedWriteOps.ts) is: hooks import SDK functions directly, extract state from stores, and pass as explicit params — no adapter layer.
BYO-IPFS config pattern (ECIES encrypt, IPNS publish, 10s timeout fallback) is the canonical template for storing user settings in encrypted vault metadata.
@cipherbox/crypto had a circular devDependency on @cipherbox/core only for vault-ipns.test.ts — fixed by replacing with hardcoded test vectors.
getSdkClient().getContext() is an O(1) field access on a singleton — not expensive despite 11 call sites, not worth caching.
vault-settings.store.ts Zustand store had 5 unused state fields and 4 unused actions (isLoading, isSaving, error etc.) because VaultTab manages saving state locally.
The recycle bin retention was previously a server-side env var (RECYCLE_BIN_RETENTION_DAYS); Phase 39 moved ownership to the client's encrypted vault settings.
Tree utilities (getDepth, isDescendantOf, calculateSubtreeDepth) live in packages/sdk-core/src/folder/tree.ts as pure functions — easily unit-testable without mocks.

code.finding: Encrypting state used `width: 100% !important` on the fill bar; when first progress event arrived and removed the pulse class, the fill snapped from 100% to 0% causing a visible flash. Fixed by applying shimmer gradient to the track and hiding the fill (opacity: 0) during encryption.
FolderNode construction was duplicated across two branches with 7 shared fields — simplified to extract shared fields into a variable.
versionCids is Array<{cid: string; size: number}>, not string[] — extracting .cid is required when building the unpinning list. Also: metadata should be saved before pruning versionCids, not after.
retentionDays validation should be inside withOperation (not before it) so errors are properly surfaced. Duplicate @cipherbox/core imports needed merging after Phase 38 migration.
Phase 39 introduced identical 12-line delete logic in both handleDelete and handleDeleteItems — extracted to a shared deleteWithBehavior() helper.
getMaxVersionsPerFile() was called twice per prune site (once for .slice(0,N) and once for .slice(N)) — should be captured in a local variable.

workflow: Background execution agents must run in isolated worktrees — without isolation they fight over the working tree and commit to whichever branch happens to be checked out, causing mis-targeted commits.

When two background agents commit to different branches (plan vs context), branch divergence requires manual merge with conflict resolution before the GSD init tool can accurately detect phase status.

The GSD init manager tool determines phase status from disk state (plan files, context files) not from git branch — branches can diverge without affecting the dashboard accuracy as long as files exist on the checked-out branch.
CodeRabbit/Copilot review threads take a few minutes to appear after PR creation — checking immediately after creation yields no threads.
The /simplify skill runs three parallel agents (reuse, quality, efficiency) — launching them all in one message is correct; they should receive the full diff as context.

friction: Phase 38 planner and executor each committed to different branches (docs/phase-38-plan vs docs/phase-38-context), requiring manual merge and conflict resolution.
Phase 39 executor (pre-worktree) committed on docs/phase-38-context instead of docs/phase-39-context, contaminating the working tree with Phase 39 changes that had to be cleaned up with git restore.
Usage limits hit mid-session, interrupting both the Phase 39 executor and the Phase 38 simplify agents — had to relaunch after reset.
Cherry-picking the upload CSS fix to fix/upload-progress-flash got confused by stash state and empty cherry-picks from the background executor's branch switching.
The worktree executor for Phase 39 started fresh instead of continuing from Wave 1 (which was already committed by the earlier executor), requiring a targeted Wave 2-only continuation prompt.
Simplify agents were initially launched against the wrong branch (docs/phase-39-context instead of docs/phase-38-context) after a failed stash+checkout sequence.
open_items: Server-side RECYCLE_BIN_RETENTION_DAYS env var should be formally deprecated with a migration guide now that client-side vault settings own retention.
3-second setTimeout in VaultTab lacks cleanup on unmount — skipped as negligible but is technically a leak.
uint8ToBase64 is duplicated across sdk-core/src/file/index.ts and other files — pre-existing, not addressed in this session.
purgeExpired() in CipherBoxClient has no dedicated unit tests — delegated to existing client-extended.test.ts coverage but not actually verified.
PR #423 (Phase 39) had no review threads at session end — review comments may appear later and need resolution.

Phase 39 executor's worktree branch (worktree-agent-acddc7e3) was cleaned up but confirmed the earlier non-worktree executor got further — the worktree approach needs the prompt to explicitly specify which wave to continue from.
